title: Extending a linear map from a finite locally free stalk
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M,N$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_W$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with $M$ finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], and $x\in W$. Every $\mathcal O_{W,x}$-linear map $t:M_x\to N_x$ on stalks [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] extends to a morphism $f:M|_U\to N|_U$ on an open $U$ containing $x$. Precisely, for every open $V$ of $U$ containing $x$ and section $m$ of $M|_U$ on $V$, the germ in $N_x$ of $f(m)$ equals $t$ of the germ of $m$. No finiteness condition is imposed on $N$.

source.place: Lemma 10.79.2, label lemma-map-between-finitely-presented; finite generator and finite relation argument specialized to a free frame

proof.text: Choose a finite free frame of M on C containing x. Reuse the private coordinate constructions and sum_coordinate_basis theorem from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteLocallyFreeStalkFinrank via a proof-only import all: every germ is the sum of its coordinates times the basis germs. These helpers allow an arbitrary finite index type and do not require constant rank on the whole scheme.

Represent the images under t of the finitely many basis germs by sections of N. Intersect their domains with C and restrict these sections to U. Form the morphism as the finite sum of each restricted coordinate projection followed by the unit morphism given by the selected section.

On every smaller open V containing x, evaluate this finite sum and take germs. Germs commute with sums and scalar multiplication; the selected germs equal the t-images of the basis germs. Linearity of t and the coordinate expansion prove the required equality. Empty frames give the zero map and no equations.

proof_origin.place: Finite free sheaf version of the finite generator/relations argument, expanded and proved in Lean by T3; coordinate constructions and expansion reused from FiniteLocallyFreeStalkFinrank rather than duplicated

theorem exists_restrict_stalk_hom_lift
    {W : Scheme.{u}} (M N : W.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (x : W)
    (t : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor W.toRingedSpace x).obj M ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor W.toRingedSpace x).obj N) :
    ∃ (U : W.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U)
      (f : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ⟶ (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj N),
      ∀ (V : U.toScheme.Opens) (hxV : (⟨x, hxU⟩ : U.toScheme) ∈ V)
        (m : Γ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M, V)),
        N.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxV, rfl⟩ (Hom.app f V m) =
          t (M.presheaf.germ (U.ι ''ᵁ V) x ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hxV, rfl⟩ m)
